project_type: React 18 SPA with Vite + TypeScript (EdTech platform)
test_framework: No test framework configured in frontend
verification_instructions: Run typecheck: cd /projects/sandbox/madarek/frontend && npx tsc -b --noEmit. Verify CSS brace balance. Grep to confirm branding text changes.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network, no npm install possible. Work with existing node_modules.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode. No npm install, no Docker, no external downloads. Must work with pre-installed dependencies only. Use AST/grep validation instead of build.
contribution_requirements: Preserve RTL support, existing functionality, routing, and business logic. Keep references to university name in educational content/data.
key_patterns: CSS uses custom properties from tokens.css/stitch-tokens.css. Components use lucide-react icons. Landing page uses Reveal component for scroll animations. RTL layout uses logical properties (inset-inline, margin-inline). Glass morphism pattern used throughout (var(--glass-bg), backdrop-filter).
directory_structure: frontend/src/components/ (shared components), frontend/src/components/layout/ (AppShell, Sidebar, Topbar, GlobalSearch), frontend/src/pages/ (page components), frontend/src/styles/ (all CSS files), frontend/public/brand/ (logo/brand assets)
